system.description:
Once per long rest, mark a Stress to
create a projected copy, remote
persona, hard-light avatar, hacked
broadcast body, or social proxy of
yourself that can appear anywhere
you've been before.
You can see and hear through the a
projection as though it were you and
affect the world as though you were
there.
A creature investigating the projection
can tell it’s artificial, digital, or
technologically generated.
This effect lasts until your next rest or
your projection takes any damage.
